name: Liveblocks landing page by liveblocks.io
description: A near-black developer landing page where hierarchy is carried almost entirely by type scale and luminance rather than colour. The top edge fades from a faint blue-violet glow into solid black, framing a tight 72px nav and a centred hero: a pill-shaped announcement badge, a two-line display headline at roughly 64-72px, a muted grey subheadline, then a single white pill CTA beside a quiet text link. Density stays extremely low and spacing generous until a blurred product visual begins to emerge from the black below, hinting at the demo without breaking the monochrome mood.
